name: BlackRock, Inc.
blurb: BlackRock, Inc. is a publicly owned investment manager that provides services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors, including pension plans, insurance companies, and governments. The firm manages a wide range of equity, fixed income, and balanced portfolios, and also offers global risk management and advisory services. As of May 2026, BlackRock has a market capitalization of approximately $174 billion and employs over 21,000 people. It is one of the world's largest asset managers, with a strong market position in the financial services industry.
recent: In the past 30 days, BlackRock's stock has traded in a range of $1,058.49 to $1,080.74, with a recent price of $1,067.74 as of May 7, 2026. The company reported earnings on April 14, 2026, and analysts maintain a Strong Buy rating with a price target of $1,275.21. The stock has shown a year-to-date increase of 25.6% in market cap, despite a slight decline in net income year-over-year.
